record.question: In which country will the first-ever solutions-focused event "Global Cooling Innovation Summit" be held?
record.explanation: Answer D: India. The first Global Cooling Innovation Summit was held in New Delhi, India, on 12–13 November 2018. The Science and Technology Ministry’s original opening-day release identifies the host city and country, so India is the unique choice. Historical/source note: The paper retains will be held even though the event had already taken place before April 2019. This is a dated event-identity answer, not a future schedule today. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=1552462&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
